Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: Exact PvP nameplate/LB cues, reliable held helpers, Smart Target, and survival tools.
Description: A local PvP HUD with exact native-nameplate cues, LB activation and damage notifications, pressure and CC awareness, a bounded Purify-first held-action scheduler, Smart Target and assist macros, local MP sounds, survival/job helpers, team communication, and target highlights.
Changelog: Adds a visible /autoseiton ON/OFF tile with ready sparkle while retaining held-key consent and Purify-first priority; /smarttab ranks exact reachable harmful-action targets with <t> fallback. BRD/WHM/NIN protection-end counter-CC now freezes at release and waits inside a 3-second lease, while Guardian can rescue 21-35% HP allies only under fresh exact 3+ pressure. A client-accepted automatic Guard now blocks accidental Action/PvPAction cancellation through its exact live status, while Guard reuse remains deliberate release. Retires Combat Frames and moves enemy LB icons/durations to native nameplates, with a safe self LB banner and ally LB damage feed. Adds local 4000/2000 MP sounds and a one-time What's New popup for every release. Custom-repo listing is visible again; schema 32.
